title: OpenHeadProtocol
description: All OpenHead protocol 0.3.0 schemas in one document. Generated from protocol/schema by tools/protocol.py; do not edit.

Ack.title: Ack
Ack.description: Successful reply to a command. Commands that return data put it in `result`; its shape is the command schema's `$defs/result`.

Command.title: Command
Command.description: Base for commands. Every command is answered with `ack` or `error` carrying the same `id`.

id.description: Client-chosen id, echoed in the reply.

CommonMode.title: CommonMode
CommonMode.description: Camera ownership mode. Only `idle` is supported in 0.1.

CommonName.title: CommonName
CommonName.description: Lower-case identifier used for themes and emotions.

CommonTopic.title: CommonTopic
CommonTopic.description: Subscribable stream. `faces` needs mode `capture` or `sensing`, `pose` needs `sensing`; `gps` asks for location access and `env` for Motion & Fitness access on first use.

DisplayClear.title: DisplayClear
DisplayClear.description: Remove any image or web page and show the face full screen.

DisplayHud.title: DisplayHud
DisplayHud.description: Put your own information on the camera view's HUD, on top of the theme. `values` are variables for templates ({speed}, {task}); they are merged with earlier ones (send null to remove one). `blocks` are extra text blocks and `widgets` extra instruments, as in a HUD theme; each replaces the previous ones sent this way. `clear` removes everything added with this command. Kept until cleared, across HUD themes.

DisplayShow.title: DisplayShow
DisplayShow.description: Change what fills the screen. `content` is named so to avoid clashing with the envelope's `type`. Images (PNG, JPEG, GIF including animated, WebP, SVG) come as an http(s) URL the device fetches, or as a `data:image/...;base64,` URI under 1 MB. Video comes as an http(s) URL (H.264 or HEVC in MP4/MOV; the simulator plays H.264, VP9 and AV1); without `loop` the face returns when it ends. `camera` shows the front camera with a HUD theme (`hud`) drawn over it: boxes around faces, the locked target, text; it switches to mode `capture` if needed. With `overlay: face-corner` the face keeps running in a corner.

source.description: Required for `image`, `video` and `web`. `video` and `web` accept http(s) URLs only.

hud.description: `camera` only: HUD theme from `face.list` (`huds`), or `none` for the bare camera. Default `hunter`.

loop.description: `video` only: start again at the end. Default false.

duration_ms.description: Return to the face after this time. Omit to hold.

DisplaySubtitle.title: DisplaySubtitle
DisplaySubtitle.description: Text on top of whatever is shown (face, image, video, web page): for a robot without a speaker, or to show an AI answer as it streams in. `replace` shows `text` alone, `append` adds it to what is shown (send tokens as they arrive), `clear` removes it. The newest three lines stay visible. With `mouth` the face's mouth moves with the text at reading pace, as if speaking.

text.description: Plain text; a line break starts a new line. Required unless `mode` is `clear`.

duration_ms.description: Clear this long after the last update. Omit to hold until replaced or cleared.

mouth.description: Move the mouth with the text at reading pace. Default false; ignored while `face.envelope` is streaming.

Env.title: Env
Env.description: Barometer, magnetometer and compass, up to 10 Hz. A field is left out when the device lacks the sensor or has no reading yet; the barometer needs Motion & Fitness access, which the first subscription asks for. Magnetic field in the `imu` device frame (+x right, +y up, +z out of the screen, portrait). Every available field is present unless the subscription named `fields`.

relative_altitude_m.description: Change in altitude in metres since the barometer started (this subscription or an earlier one still running).

magnetic_field_ut.description: Raw magnetic field in microtesla, device frame; includes the device's own bias.

heading_deg.description: Compass heading of the screen's top edge as the head is mounted (landscape), degrees clockwise from north.

heading_ref.description: `true` north needs location access; otherwise magnetic north.

sensor_time_s.description: Seconds since device boot (the clock of `imu`).

EnvPayload.title: EnvPayload
EnvPayload.description: Payload when the subscription names no `fields`: every reading the device has.

Envelope.title: Envelope
Envelope.description: Fields carried by every OpenHead message.

ts.description: Sender clock in milliseconds since the Unix epoch.

Expressions.title: Expressions
Expressions.description: A theme's `expressions.json`: a face parameter preset per shared emotion name, plus theme-specific ones under `extra`. Only `neutral` is required and must set every parameter; missing shared names fall back to it. Parameters a preset leaves out keep the neutral value.

ExpressionsParams.title: ExpressionsParams
ExpressionsParams.description: Face parameters. Eyes and mouth in [0, 1] or [-1, 1]; global values normalised.

FaceBlink.title: FaceBlink
FaceBlink.description: Blink once now, in the theme's blink style.

FaceEnvelope.title: FaceEnvelope
FaceEnvelope.description: Mouth envelope from the host's speech audio, sent as a stream at 20-30 Hz while speaking. Not a command: no `id` and no reply. The face decays to closed if no update arrives for 200 ms.

FaceList.title: FaceList
FaceList.description: List installed face themes with their expressions, and HUD themes for the camera view.

expressions.description: Shared emotion names the theme defines.

FaceLookAt.title: FaceLookAt
FaceLookAt.description: Point the gaze. `screen`: `x`, `y` in [-1, 1] with origin at the screen centre, +x right, +y up. `head`: `yaw`, `pitch` in degrees in the head frame, +yaw left, +pitch up. `face`: follow a detected face (`faces` topic) until another `look_at`: `face_id`, or the locked (largest) face when omitted; the gaze rests when no face is seen. The world frame needs pose and arrives later.

face_id.description: `face` only: the face to follow; default the locked (largest) face.

duration_ms.description: Hold the gaze, then return to idle motion. Omit to hold until the next `look_at`.

FaceSetEmotion.title: FaceSetEmotion
FaceSetEmotion.description: Blend towards an emotion, independently of speech (the mouth envelope is added on top). Shared names, defined by every built-in theme: neutral, happy, curious, thinking, surprised, sad, angry, sleepy, scared, mischievous, confused, shocked, excited, bored, skeptical, worried, disgusted, embarrassed, proud, determined, relieved, annoyed, suspicious, laughing, disappointed, focused, nervous, smug. Themes may add extras (see `face.list`). Names the theme lacks fall back to `neutral` with a warning in the log.

duration_ms.description: Return to the resting emotion after this time. Omit to hold.

blend.description: `replace` fades out other emotions; `add` layers on top. Default `replace`.

FaceSetTheme.title: FaceSetTheme
FaceSetTheme.description: Switch the face to an installed theme. Unknown names give `invalid_params`.

Faces.title: Faces
Faces.description: People in front of the head, up to 15 Hz while mode is `capture` (front camera, several faces, with `box`) or `sensing` (ARKit, one face, no `box`). Angles are in the head frame like `face.look_at`: +bearing to the head's left, +elevation up, in degrees. An empty list means nobody is seen. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`.

FacesBox.title: FacesBox
FacesBox.description: Where the face is in the camera view as shown on screen, normalised 0-1, origin top-left.

id.description: Stable while the face stays in view.

size.description: Face width as a share of the camera's field of view: bigger is closer.

distance_m.description: Metres, when the depth camera measures it (`sensing`).

locked.description: The face the HUD and `look_at {frame: face}` follow.

FacesPayload.title: FacesPayload
FacesPayload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.

Gps.title: Gps
Gps.description: Where the head is on Earth, up to 1 Hz and only when there is a new fix, so a head standing still may send nothing for a while (CoreLocation: GNSS where the device has it, otherwise Wi-Fi). Sent only after the user allows location access; the first subscription asks. WGS 84. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`; `alt_m`, `v_accuracy_m`, `speed_m_s` and `course_deg` are left out when unknown.

alt_m.description: Altitude above mean sea level in metres.

h_accuracy_m.description: Radius of horizontal uncertainty in metres (68 %).

course_deg.description: Direction of travel, degrees clockwise from true north.

sensor_time_s.description: When the fix was taken, seconds since device boot (the clock of `imu`).

GpsPayload.title: GpsPayload
GpsPayload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.

Hello.title: Hello
Hello.description: First message on a new connection. Without a valid token the device answers `pair_required`; with one it answers `welcome`. The major version must match the device's.

client.description: Human-readable client name, shown on the pairing screen and in the client list.

Hud.title: Hud
Hud.description: A HUD theme (`face/huds/<name>/hud.json`): what is drawn over the camera view. Text lines are templates. Built in: {faces} faces seen, {target} locked face id or NONE, {status} LOCKED or SEARCHING, {id} {conf} {bearing} {elevation} {size} of the locked face, {frame} frame counter, {time} timecode since the view opened, {rand:N} N random digits; from the device: {battery} percent, {charging} YES/NO, {thermal} nominal/fair/serious/critical, {heading} compass degrees, {heading_name} N/NE/E..., {pitch} and {roll} degrees, {x} {y} {z} position in metres and {tracking} (mode sensing), {mode}, {clients}, {lat} {lon} {alt} {gps_acc} (while `gps` runs), {pressure} hPa (while `env` runs). Hosts add their own with `display.hud {values}` and use them the same way, e.g. {speed}. Unknown names show as `-`.

shadow.description: Glow or shadow behind text and lines.

tint.description: Colour laid over the camera image (works over a native camera view too).

boxes.description: How every detected face is marked.

lock.description: How the locked face (the largest, or the one `look_at` follows) is marked.

label.description: Shown big near the bottom while locked.

boot.description: Lines typed out one by one when the view opens, then kept on screen at the left.

size.description: Text size; 1 is about 4.5% of the screen height.

HudWidget.title: HudWidget
HudWidget.description: An instrument drawn from device values.

type.description: `compass`: heading tape; `horizon`: artificial horizon from pitch and roll; `battery`: level and charging.

at.description: Default: top for compass, center for horizon, top-right for battery.

Imu.title: Imu
Imu.description: Inertial sample, up to 100 Hz. Right-handed frame: in `device` frame +x is right, +y is up and +z points out of the screen (portrait). `mount` applies the `mount_offset` setting. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`; then only those are.

q.description: Orientation as unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], relative to a gravity-aligned reference frame.

accel.description: Specific force in m/s^2, as a ROS IMU reports it: at rest upright about +9.81 on +y. (iOS CoreMotion reports the opposite sign.)

sensor_time_s.description: Sensor timestamp in seconds since device boot, for precise intervals between samples.

ImuPayload.title: ImuPayload
ImuPayload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.

Log.title: Log
Log.description: One structured log line, sent as it happens. Every received command is logged with its `seq` in `seq_ref`. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`; then only those are.

seq_ref.description: `seq` of the received message this line is about.

LogPayload.title: LogPayload
LogPayload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.

ModeSet.title: ModeSet
ModeSet.description: Choose who owns the cameras. `idle`: no camera (default). `capture`: the front camera runs for the camera view and face detection (`faces` with boxes, several faces); pose only as orientation from `imu`. `sensing`: ARKit owns the cameras: world tracking gives `pose` (position and orientation) and one face is tracked with the depth camera (`faces` without boxes); no camera image. Asks for camera permission the first time; `unsupported` where the device cannot.

Pair.title: Pair
Pair.description: Pairing attempt with the code shown on the device. Answered with `welcome`, or `error` with `unauthorized` (wrong code) or `rate_limited` (locked for five minutes after five failures).

code.description: Devices show six digits; the simulator accepts `0000` in dev mode.

PairRequired.title: PairRequired
PairRequired.description: Sent by the device when `hello` has no valid token. The device shows a pairing code on screen.

code_hint.description: Where to find the code, e.g. "6-digit code shown on head-01".

Pose.title: Pose
Pose.description: Where the head is, up to 60 Hz while mode is `sensing` (ARKit world tracking). World frame: origin where tracking started, +y up (against gravity), +x and +z horizontal; position in metres. `q` turns the device frame of `imu` into the world frame ([x, y, z, w]). Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`.

q.description: Unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], device frame to world frame.

PosePayload.title: PosePayload
PosePayload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.

Status.title: Status
Status.description: Device status, up to 1 Hz. Also the result of `system.status`. Every payload field is present unless the subscription named `fields`; then only those are.

subtitle.description: Subtitle text on screen. Omitted when none.

faces.description: Faces seen now (modes `capture` and `sensing`). Omitted in `idle`.

rtt_ms.description: Round-trip time to the receiving client, from WebSocket ping. Omitted until measured.

StatusPayload.title: StatusPayload
StatusPayload.description: Complete payload, as sent when the subscription names no `fields`.

Subscribe.title: Subscribe
Subscribe.description: Open a stream. The device clamps `rate_hz` to what it supports and returns the actual rate. Subscribing again to the same topic replaces the earlier subscription.

rate_hz.description: Requested rate. Ignored for event-driven topics such as `log`.

fields.description: Only send these payload fields. Omit for all.

SystemDiagnostics.title: SystemDiagnostics
SystemDiagnostics.description: Health snapshot for debugging. Dev mode only.

frame_rate.description: Face render rate over the last second.

location.description: For `gps` and true-north heading; absent from 0.2 devices.

motion_fitness.description: For the barometer in `env`; absent from 0.2 devices.

face_tracking.description: Front-camera face tracking concurrent with world tracking.

SystemLogs.title: SystemLogs
SystemLogs.description: Most recent lines from the device's log ring buffer (2000 lines), oldest first. Dev mode only.

SystemScreenshot.title: SystemScreenshot
SystemScreenshot.description: PNG of what is on screen. Dev mode only. With `delivery: url` the image is served by the device's HTTP server (WebSocket port + 1) for 60 s and must be fetched with the token in an `Authorization: Bearer` header.

SystemSettings.title: SystemSettings
SystemSettings.description: Read all settings, or set one. `set` needs dev mode. Known keys in 0.1: `name`, `port`, `mount_offset` ([x, y, z, w] quaternion), `offline_theme`.

value.description: Any JSON value valid for the key.

SystemStatus.title: SystemStatus
SystemStatus.description: Current status, same content as the `status` topic.

Theme.title: Theme
Theme.description: A theme's `theme.json`: look and idle behaviour of the face. Expressions live in `expressions.json` next to it; images in `assets/`. Lengths are fractions of the screen's shortest side.

layout.title: ThemeLayout
layout.description: Placement relative to the screen centre. Defaults are the engine's.

pixelate.description: Pixel block size in points; 0 for off.

envelope.title: ThemeEnvelope
envelope.description: How the speech envelope drives mouth `open`: open = gain * level^gamma, smoothed with attack/release.

resting_emotion.description: Emotion shown when nothing else is set. Default `neutral`.

ThemeRangeMs.title: ThemeRangeMs
ThemeRangeMs.description: [min, max] in milliseconds; a value is drawn uniformly each time.

ThemeShape.title: ThemeShape
ThemeShape.description: One of: a built-in preset, an SVG path in normalised coordinates ([-1, 1] box), or an image from `assets/`.

anchor.description: Point in the image placed at the feature centre. Default [0.5, 0.5].

Unsubscribe.title: Unsubscribe
Unsubscribe.description: Close a stream. Acknowledged even if the topic was not subscribed.

Welcome.title: Welcome
Welcome.description: Session accepted. Carries the client's token (new after pairing, unchanged on reconnect), the device description and what it supports.

capabilities.description: Feature flags. Known: 0.1 `face`, `display.image`, `display.video`, `display.web`, `display.subtitle`, `imu`, `status`, `log`, `screenshot`; 0.2 `camera`, `faces`, `pose` (where the device supports them); 0.3 `gps`, `env`. Clients ignore unknown values.
